tasks.title: City player sprite renders under the city map floor
tasks.details:
In CityRun the Player is scene-authored at tree index 0 while build() adds the CityMap later (index 4), so the opaque block floor draws over the player sprite in every city run. Pre-existing since T026 and invisible to tests; found during the T036 Xvfb visual check (zero player-blue pixels in the frame while the probe confirmed player position, camera clamp, and visibility flags). Evidence: Xvfb probe printed player_index=0, map_index=4, player_visible=true; full-frame scan for the player color (51, 89, 178) found 0 pixels in game runs, while the same scan sees the player in the cafe scene.

tasks.title: City completion screen never dismisses and permanently stands down the touch controls
tasks.details:
Acceptance: after the city-complete beat, the game returns control to the player. The completion screen needs a dismiss path (a continue button or a timed fade) and the touch layer must come back, so the player can walk to the road-east trigger and keep playing, including post-city side quests. An integration test drives a city to completion and asserts the overlay clears and the touch controls return; make check green.
Evidence: game/scripts/city/city_run.gd:601-605 _on_city_completed calls _show_end_screen(..., false); city_run.gd:624-629 sets _end_screen_shown and shows the overlay, and grep shows no writer that ever clears them (only _ready initializes and _show_end_screen sets). city_run.gd:184 feeds _end_screen_shown into touch_controls.set_overlay_open, and game/scripts/touch/touch_controls.gd:66-84 _process hides the whole layer while _overlay_open is true. Executable probe (headless SceneTree script on pourtland.tscn): before completion touch layer visible=true; after progress.mark_tower_off() plus progress.mark_boss_cured(): overlay=true, restart button visible=false, touch layer visible=false; 5 seconds later still false while the player is awake and unlocked. A touch-only player, the target platform per CLAUDE.md, is stuck after the victory beat; a desktop player keeps a permanent 55 percent dim overlay. Distinct from T069 (death overlay reload) and T088 (physics-callback error on the same travel path). Latent in live play only because no city can complete today (T027 boss missing, T049 gate locked), but it fires on every completion once those land.

tasks.title: Van level 3 is unreachable in live play: total scrap (14) is below the 17 needed, and the bag resets every city, locking the Sleepvana crowd step and the field cafe forever
tasks.details:
Section 10 van level 3 (field cafe) and the Sleepvana crowd recruit are unreachable through normal play. Acceptance: either lower/raise the scrap sources so a player who scavenges Steamtle can fund kitchen (5) plus field cafe (12), or place extra scrap rewards, or carry the bag across cities; then pin with an integration test that reaches an open field base in Steamtle using only gameplay loot (no load_state), and confirm the Sleepvana recruit step runs.
Evidence: game/resources/balance/mobile_cafe.tres: kitchen_scrap_cost 5, field_cafe_scrap_cost 12 (17 total; levels step in order). game/scripts/city/city_block_view.gd:41 KIT_SCRAP_AMOUNT := 2 is the only scrap source in the game (grep over scripts found no other grant). Scavenge blocks (kind 4) per city definition: san_coffesco 3 (6 scrap), steamtle 2 (4), pourtland 2 (4) = 14 across all three cities, below 17 even with perfect carry-over. The bag never carries over: each city scene rebuilds the Player with an empty Inventory (scene-authored in city_run.tscn) and MovingDay holds only a done flag (game/scripts/city/moving_day.gd), so its 'carries all belongings' promise is a toast today (cross-city carry is T049 scope, but 14 < 17 defeats it anyway). CityRun loads the van at Level.VAN in every city after the first (game/scripts/city/city_run.gd:476), so Steamtle starts at level 1 with 4 scrap available: even the 5-scrap kitchen is out of reach there. Sleepvana's recruit requires an open level 3 field base (game/scripts/quests/sleepvana_stage.gd try_interact checks van.is_field_base_open()), so the quest's encore and concert wake event cannot be reached in live play. The suite stays green because test_sleepvana.gd:295 force-loads MobileCafe.Level.FIELD_CAFE, bypassing the economy.

Combined with per-city scrap totals (San Coffesco 6, Steamtle 4, Pourtland 4, each below the 17 total and even below the 12 field cafe cost), no accumulation path exists at all. Acceptance: the T101 fix must either carry the van level across the moving-day boundary or make each city's loot fund its upgrades alone, pinned by an integration test that reaches an open level 3 field base in Steamtle through gameplay loot only, with the van level surviving the San Coffesco to Steamtle move.
Evidence: game/scripts/city/city_run.gd:474-476: 'van_state = MobileCafe.new(_van.balance); if city_index > 1: van_state.load_state(MobileCafe.Level.VAN)'. game/resources/balance/mobile_cafe.tres: kitchen_scrap_cost 5, field_cafe_scrap_cost 12. Scavenge blocks (kind 4) per city resource: san_coffesco 3, steamtle 2, pourtland 2, times KIT_SCRAP_AMOUNT 2 (city_block_view.gd:46). game/resources/city/*.tres kind counts verified by grep.

tasks.title: Circular preload between tutorial_director.gd and city_run.gd can silently build a city with no cafe safe zone, no spawn marker, and no pole zones
tasks.details:
Latent resource-cycle defect: when tutorial_director.gd compiles before city_run.gd, city_block_view.gd's SLEEP_ZONE_SCENE preload resolves to an empty PackedScene and the city builds broken with zero test failures. Acceptance: break the cycle (drop the CityRun/CityMap type hints in tutorial_director.gd to plain Node plus duck calls, or lazy-load the TUTORIAL_SCENE preload in city_run.gd), and add a smoke assert that a built city run contains its cafe safe zone, CafeSpawn marker, and three pole zones, so no compile order can ship a broken world.
Evidence: Cycle: game/scripts/tutorial/tutorial_director.gd holds typed _run/CityRun references while game/scripts/city/city_run.gd:13 preloads tutorial_director.tscn. Reproduction under Xvfb (DISPLAY=:77, godot --path game --resolution 1280x720 --script): a SceneTree harness whose compile-time TutorialDirector type hint loads the tutorial graph before the menu, then menu -> Play, boots SanCoffescoIntro with 4x 'ERROR: Failed to instantiate scene state of "", node count is 0' at city_block_view.gd:177 and :204 (the cafe SAFE zone and the three SLEEP pole zones), followed by SCRIPT ERROR name-on-Nil and 'global_position on null instance'. Verified consequences: Zones/CafeSafeZone missing (harness inspection safe=false), so no meter shelter, no free-refill zone, no CafeSpawn, no pole drain, and the tutorial stalls at the drink step. Deterministic: 12/12 runs with the hint failed; 19/19 runs without it (menu->play->inspect variants, plus direct intro boot) built a clean world, which is why make check, the workers' direct-boot Xvfb harnesses, and the real desktop flow never see it. Nothing guarantees this compile order stays benign on Android (the target platform, T052) or after future autoloads (T040).
